name: Combat Escapist (Ex)
body:
Benefit: A rogue with this talent may escape grapples or pins as a movement action, and may make Escape Artist attempts that usually take a full-round action as a standard action . If the rogue successfully escapes a grapple or pin , her grappler is considered flat-footed to the rogue ’s next attack until the end of the rogue ’s turn.
